import subprocess, sys, json
prog = [sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/main.py"]
valid = b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}'

def rows(data):
    p = subprocess.run(prog, input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=180)
    assert p.returncode == 0 and not p.stderr, p.stderr[:300]
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.split(b"\n") if l.strip()]

out = rows(valid + b"    \n" + valid + b"\n")
print("trailing ws rows:", len(out)); assert len(out) == 2

out = rows(b"\n" + valid)
print("leading empty line:", [str(r)[:30] for r in out])
